dossier.scp_unleashed.500.title: Panacea
dossier.scp_unleashed.500.caption: SCP-500 at intake, set on felt beside a scale rule. Eight capsules were counted and put back.
dossier.scp_unleashed.500.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.500.page.0.text.0: SCP-500 is kept in a locked medical cabinet in a secure storage room. The cabinet is opened only to dispense a capsule on the written approval of the Site Director, or for an approved test.
dossier.scp_unleashed.500.page.0.text.1: The capsules in SCP-500 are to be counted and the count logged every time the cabinet is opened. **No capsule is to leave the site.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.500.page.0.text.2: Staff are reminded that SCP-500 is not a first aid kit. %rRequests for a capsule after minor injuries will be refused.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.500.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.500.page.1.text.0: SCP-500 is a small red plastic pill bottle with a white childproof cap and an old pharmacy label, worn and faded past reading. When full it holds eight small capsules, each coloured in two shades of red.
dossier.scp_unleashed.500.page.1.text.1: A single capsule, swallowed, restores the subject completely within moments. Hurts close, sickness passes, and lingering afflictions of an anomalous kind lift with them. Subjects also report feeling rested and well fed, whatever their state beforehand. The effect is the same whoever takes it.
dossier.scp_unleashed.500.page.1.text.2: Capsules taken out of SCP-500 keep their effect. Every attempt to find out what they are made of has failed. %rFurther analysis has been suspended to conserve capsules.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.500.page.1.text.3: The bottle has never been seen to refill. Even so, counts taken some days apart have found it full again.
dossier.scp_unleashed.500.page.2.title: Addendum 500-1: Test Log
dossier.scp_unleashed.500.page.2.text.0: Test 500-03: D-8812, exhausted and hungry after a long work detail, was given one capsule. Within seconds he said he felt "like I slept a full night and ate a big breakfast."
dossier.scp_unleashed.500.page.2.text.1: Test 500-06: a researcher suffering a lingering affliction described in another file took one capsule. The affliction lifted at once and has not returned.
dossier.scp_unleashed.500.page.2.text.2: Test 500-08: a capsule was given to an injured guard dog. It recovered fully and was back on duty the same day.
dossier.scp_unleashed.500.page.2.text.3: Test 500-11: the cabinet was sealed with three capsules inside and left untouched. When it was opened again, the count no longer matched the log. See containment procedures.
dossier.scp_unleashed.500.page.3.title: Addendum 500-2: Provenance
dossier.scp_unleashed.500.page.3.text: SCP-500 has no recovery record. It was handed to a reader of this file by the individual in Foundation dress described in the files of other objects. The courier asked that the capsules not be wasted, and did not stay. See field notes.

block.scp_unleashed.scp500_bottle.detail: Set it down and use it to shake out a pill
Leave it be for a while and it is full again
item.scp_unleashed.scp500_pill.tooltip: A small red capsule in two shades of red. It is lighter than it looks.
item.scp_unleashed.scp500_pill.detail.0: Use to swallow it at once
item.scp_unleashed.scp500_pill.detail.1: Use it on someone else to give it to them
jade.scp_unleashed.scp500_bottle.soon: It will be full again soon
jade.scp_unleashed.scp500_bottle.days: It will be full again in about %s days
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp500_bottle.1: SCP-500, the Panacea, is a small red pill bottle with a white childproof cap and an old paper label faded past reading. It holds a handful of red capsules.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp500_bottle.2: Set it down and use it to shake a capsule into your hand. It never holds more than eight, and left alone for long enough it is found full again.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp500_bottle.3: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-500 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A courier in Foundation dress will bring it to you.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp500_pill.1: A single capsule of SCP-500. Swallowed, it puts right whatever ails the one who takes it, sickness and stranger troubles alike, and leaves them whole, rested and well fed.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp500_pill.2: It works the moment it is taken. Use it on someone else to give it to them.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp500.0: A courier brings the bottle by hand.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp500.1: One capsule mends everything. Do not waste them.
